reasons.agency_recipients: 3.0 leaves out DAC2A rows to multilateral organisations as recipients (98, 816, 878, 900-996), because they are core contributions, which the organisations' own rows carry on to the recipients they reach
reasons.imputed_providers: 3.0 leaves multilateral providers and the totals that hold them (20002, 20004, 20005) out of line 106, since the imputed shares are their own flows
reasons.crs_bilateral_rows: 3.0 counts bi_multi 1, 3, 7 and 8 only, so rows with no bi_multi and multilateral organisations' own outflows (bi_multi 4) are left out, and for a multilateral provider, oecd.crs.multilateral_oda holds its ODA outflows
reasons.crs_oof_rows: 3.0 counts bi_multi 1, 3, 7 and 8 only, so rows with no bi_multi and multilateral organisations' own outflows (bi_multi 4) are left out, and for a multilateral provider, oecd.crs.multilateral_oof holds its other official flows
reasons.crs_psi: on grant equivalents 3.0 adds private sector instruments (category 60) to category 10
reasons.crs_sectors: 2.x compared five-digit CRS purpose codes with three-digit sector headings, so it found only activities reported at heading level and returned nothing for most codes, while 3.0 reads every purpose code under those headings
reasons.crs_other_categories: 2.x summed every CRS category, while 3.0 sums ODA (category 10) and other official flows (category 21), and oecd.crs.private_development_finance holds private development finance (category 30)
reasons.crs_private_providers: 3.0 reads the private donors in oda.groups.private_donors when a call names no providers, so the category 30 rows that Denmark, Japan, Korea, Hungary and Finland report (USD 2.7bn in all years, against USD 100.3bn from private donors) count only when a call names them
reasons.per_cent: 3.0 gives ODA/GNI in per cent, while 2.x's ONE ratios were fractions
reasons.no_2x_number: no 2.x code read settings/indicators.json, so 2.x computed no number for this slug, and 3.0 follows the slug's definition
reasons.no_2x_rows: 2.x returned no rows for this code on today's DAC1
reasons.recipient_totals: 2.x's rows also held DAC2A recipient totals, such as developing countries (10001), which 3.0 returns only when recipients= names them, so 2.x's rows summed by provider count each flow more than once
reasons.eu_gni: for EU Institutions (918), which DAC1 gives no GNI, the call takes the GNI of today's EU27 in every year, as 2.x's add_gni_share_column did
reasons.ONE.10.1010_11010: the headline basis, which reads line 1010 on net flows to 2017 and line 11010 on grant equivalents from 2018, as 2.x gave with measure=["net_disbursement", "grant_equivalent"]
reasons.ONE.40.1010_11010_1: 3.0 gives per cent, while 2.x gave a fraction rounded to six decimals
reasons.ONE.40.1010_1: 2.x raised NotImplementedError, since it shipped no oda_gni_flow function, and 3.0 gives per cent
reasons.ONE.10.1010C: 2.x's default measure, net flows. The headline basis, as oda.get("one.dac1.core_oda"), subtracts each line on grant equivalents from 2018
reasons.DAC1.40.3: 3.0 gives official and private flows (line 5) as a per cent of GNI, the definition of line 3
reasons.DAC1.40.4: 3.0 gives population in millions of people, so the call takes no unit=, and oecd.dac1.lines, which reads amounts of money, refuses line 4
reasons.DAC1.10.1500: grant equivalents start in 2018 on oecd.dac1.in_donor_student_costs, and oecd.dac1.lines with lines=1500, basis="grant_equivalent" reads 2015 to 2017
reasons.DAC1.10.1600: grant equivalents start in 2018 on oecd.dac1.debt_relief, and oecd.dac1.lines with lines=1600, basis="grant_equivalent" reads 2015 to 2017
reasons.DAC1.10.1700: grant equivalents start in 2018 on oecd.dac1.administrative_costs, and oecd.dac1.lines with lines=1700, basis="grant_equivalent" reads 2015 to 2017
reasons.DAC1.10.1810: grant equivalents start in 2018 on oecd.dac1.development_awareness, and oecd.dac1.lines with lines=1810, basis="grant_equivalent" reads 2015 to 2017
reasons.DAC1.10.1820: grant equivalents start in 2018 on oecd.dac1.in_donor_refugee_costs, and oecd.dac1.lines with lines=1820, basis="grant_equivalent" reads 2015 to 2017
reasons.DAC1.40.11002: 3.0 computes ODA over GNI in per cent, which differs from the published per cent by its rounding, up to 0.005 points
reasons.DAC1.10.11010: grant equivalents start in 2018 on oecd.dac1.total_oda, and oecd.dac1.lines with lines=11010, basis="grant_equivalent" reads 2015 to 2017
reasons.DAC1.10.11015: grant equivalents start in 2018 on oecd.dac1.bilateral_oda, and oecd.dac1.lines with lines=11015, basis="grant_equivalent" reads 2015 to 2017
reasons.DAC1.60.11030: grant equivalents start in 2018 on oecd.dac1.private_sector_instruments, and oecd.dac1.lines with lines=11030, basis="grant_equivalent" reads 2015 to 2017
reasons.DAC1.10.12000: grant equivalents start in 2018 on oecd.dac1.multilateral_oda, and oecd.dac1.lines with lines=12000, basis="grant_equivalent" reads 2015 to 2017
reasons.ONE.P.40.T.T.S_M: 2.x gave three-year rolling shares of ODA and other official flows, while this call gives single-year shares of ODA. one.crs.imputed_multilateral_oda applies the three-year shares itself
reasons.total_health_covid_oda_ge: DAC1 publishes no line 8852 in any year. one.crs.covid_oda counts bilateral ODA the CRS tags #COVID-19
reasons.total_covid_vaccine_donations_oda_ge: DAC1 publishes no line 8853 in any year. one.crs.covid_oda counts bilateral ODA the CRS tags #COVID-19
reasons.total_covid_vaccine_donations_domestic_s: DAC1 publishes no line 8854 in any year. one.crs.covid_oda counts bilateral ODA the CRS tags #COVID-19
reasons.total_covid_vaccine_donations_dev_purcha: DAC1 publishes no line 8855 in any year. one.crs.covid_oda counts bilateral ODA the CRS tags #COVID-19
reasons.total_covid_ancillary_oda_ge: DAC1 publishes no line 8856 in any year. one.crs.covid_oda counts bilateral ODA the CRS tags #COVID-19
reasons.total_psi_flow: the 2.x definition reads grant equivalents (flow 1160), despite its name, and basis="net_disbursement" reads net flows
reasons.multilateral_purpose_spending_shares: 2.x gave three-year rolling shares of ODA and other official flows by channel, while this call gives single-year shares of ODA by provider. one.crs.imputed_multilateral_oda applies the three-year shares itself
reasons.imputed_multi_flow_disbursement_gross: the imputation of 2.x's sector_imputations, row for row
